name: Tennouji Nae
source:
A cheerful worker at JAXA, daughter of Tennouji Yuugo.

[spoiler]Nae is later revealed to be working in secret with [url=/c86162]Sawada[/url] to thwart [url=/c79016]Kimijima's[/url] plans to wipe out humanity.[/spoiler]
